formulas.formula: Give generously, plan calmly, and start January with no regrets.
Setup: the year and your total holiday budget.
People: everyone you're buying for, with a budget for each.
Gifts: gift ideas for each person, with price and status: Idea, Bought, Wrapped or Given.
Holiday Costs: tree, decorations, food, cards, travel and giving.
Dashboard: days to Christmas, spent vs budget, and what's still left to buy and wrap.
Decide the total first, then split it between people and other costs.
Add ideas all year. Mark them Bought when they're in the cupboard.
Add them as their own line so they don't sneak past the budget.
Little eyes? Don't leave it open on the family computer.

=IF(R6<0,"Planned gifts and costs are over budget by "&TEXT(-R6,"$#,##0")&". Trim a few ideas.",IF(R11>0,"Still shopping for "&R11&IF(R11=1," person."," people."),IF(R9>0,R9&IF(R9=1," gift"," gifts")&" left to wrap. Put on a holiday movie!","All done. Time for cocoa!")))
=IF(R8>0,R8&IF(R8=1," day to go"," days to go"),IF(R8=0,"Merry Christmas!","See you next year"))
Planned = every gift on their list. Spent = gifts already bought, wrapped or given.
=COUNTIF(S6:S155,">=2")&" of "&COUNTIF(S6:S155,">0")&" gifts bought. "&COUNTIF(S6:S155,2)&" still to wrap."
Everything that isn't a gift. Actual replaces the budget once you know it.
